faqs: Is there a fee for an assessment, and how are treatment costs determined?
The assessment fee depends on the type of consultation. After evaluating your case, we explain your treatment options and the associated costs. You can contact us on WhatsApp before booking.
How can I book an appointment? Do you offer emergency care?
You can book your assessment online or contact us on WhatsApp. We also offer emergency care and same-day appointments when available.
Do you treat children, adults and older adults?
Yes, we provide dental care for children, adults and older adults. We do not treat babies.
How long does an appointment take, and what if I am worried about pain?
The length of your appointment depends on the procedure, although many appointments last about an hour. Before treatment, we explain what to expect and the options available to manage discomfort.
Do you offer financing or accept insurance?
We treat private patients and do not offer formal financing. During your assessment, we can discuss treatment options that suit your needs and budget.
